acceptance_criteria.criterion: resolveItemsPerPage() returns the default when GridSettings contains a value not in the current options list
New test validates stale-settings fall-through behavior

summary: Added in_array whitelist check in GridPagination::resolveItemsPerPage() for the Priority 2 (GridSettings) path. If the stored value is not in the current itemsPerPageOptions list, it falls through to $fallback (the default).

Extended GridPaginationTest with test_resolveItemsPerPage_staleSettingsValueFallsBackToDefault() that configures options [10,25,50], writes stale value 100 to GridSettings, and asserts the returned value is the default (25).
All 126 tests pass. PHPStan level 6: 0 errors.

comments.note: The in_array strict-mode check in resolveItemsPerPage() is clean and correct. No issues observed in the touched files. Code is clean and consistent.

summary: AC1 PASS: resolveItemsPerPage() Priority 2 path uses in_array strict check guarded by !empty($itemsPerPageOptions). Stale stored value 100 not in [10,25,50] correctly returns the default 25.
AC3 PASS: composer analyze — PHPStan level 6, 0 errors.
AC4 PASS: composer test — 126 tests, 246 assertions, 0 failures.

comments.note: AC1 verified by code inspection: Priority 2 path in resolveItemsPerPage() has 'if (!empty($this->itemsPerPageOptions) && !in_array($storedValue, $this->itemsPerPageOptions, true)) { $storedValue = $fallback; }'. Correctly falls back for stale settings values.

Edge-cases confirmed: (1) empty options list skips the in_array check (intentional: no constraint), (2) $value=0 not in whitelist falls back correctly, (3) $_GET Priority 1 path still takes precedence.
Test uses InMemoryStorage and creates an isolated grid instance — no test state leakage.

summary: Reviewed GridPagination::resolveItemsPerPage() Priority 2 whitelist guard and the accompanying test. Change is minimal, correct, and secure.
in_array strict-mode prevents loose coercion; the !empty guard is intentional (no options = no constraint). Fallback caching path is correct.
Test test_resolveItemsPerPage_staleSettingsValueFallsBackToDefault() is well-isolated, uses InMemoryStorage, and directly verifies the stale-detection path.
All four acceptance criteria confirmed met. PHPStan 0 errors, 126 tests passing.
No blocking issues found. One low-priority non-blocking suggestion recorded.

comments.note: GridPagination.php resolveItemsPerPage(): When a stale GridSettings value is detected and overridden with $fallback, the corrected value is not written back to GridSettings. The cache covers the object lifetime but each new request re-runs the validation with the stale data still in storage. A future improvement could call $this->grid->settings()->setItemsPerPage($fallback) at the stale-detection branch to self-heal persistent storage.

GridPagination.php L319: '$storedValue = $this->grid->settings()->getItemsPerPage($fallback) ?? $fallback' — the '?? $fallback' tail is belt-and-suspenders redundancy since getItemsPerPage($fallback) already returns $fallback when nothing is stored. Harmless, but slightly noisy.

summary: Updated api-surface.md: extended the resolveItemsPerPage() comment block from (WP-002/WP-003) to (WP-002/WP-003/WP-004); added explicit description that the GridSettings value is also re-validated against the current options list and stale values fall through to $default.
Updated data-flows.md: Priority chain step 2 now notes that the persisted GridSettings value is re-validated against the options whitelist (WP-004) and stale values fall through to step 3.
Updated README.md: added a 'Stale-setting guard' paragraph in the Built-in items-per-page selector section describing the automatic fallback when options change after a value has been saved.
